description: This Java class 'HiveAuthFactory' manages authentication mechanisms for HiveServer2, including Kerberos, LDAP, PAM, and delegation tokens. It creates Thrift transport and processor factories based on configuration, handles Kerberos login, and manages delegation tokens.

classes.name: HiveAuthFactory
classes.description: Manages authentication for HiveServer2, supporting multiple auth types, Kerberos login, delegation tokens, and creating Thrift transport and processor factories.

methods.name: getSaslProperties
methods.description: Returns SASL properties based on configuration, including QOP and server authentication.

methods.name: getAuthTransFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns the appropriate TTransportFactory based on the configured authentication type.

methods.name: getAuthProcFactory
methods.description: Returns the Thrift processor factory for HiveServer2, supporting Kerberos and plain authentication.

methods.name: getRemoteUser
methods.description: Returns the remote user name from the SASL server.

methods.name: getIpAddress
methods.description: Returns the IP address of the connected client.

methods.name: loginFromKeytab
methods.description: Performs Kerberos login using a keytab file.

methods.name: loginFromSpnegoKeytabAndReturnUGI
methods.description: Performs SPNEGO login and returns the UserGroupInformation.

methods.name: getDelegationToken
methods.description: Retrieves a delegation token for a user.

methods.name: getUserFromToken
methods.description: Extracts user information from a delegation token.

methods.name: needUgiLogin
methods.description: Determines if UGI login is needed based on current user credentials.

methods.name: getKeytabFromUgi
methods.description: Uses reflection to get the keytab path from the current UGI.
